expected_navigation_cancellations.interpretation: The saved strict report lists only resources from a selected context immediately superseded by the next sequential deep link. Each successor reached ready state and has a screenshot; local import then completed. This is recorded separately from HTTP or application failures, not discarded.

diagnostics.chromium: no console errors, page errors, failed requests, HTTP >=400 responses, or benchmark requests
diagnostics.firefox: no console errors, page errors, HTTP >=400 responses, or benchmark requests; six expected navigation cancellations are retained above and make the unmodified raw strict report fail

limitations: The strict raw runner records Firefox startup metrics only after clean diagnostics, so Firefox timing and byte totals are unavailable in this run despite all selected contexts reaching ready state.
Later dataset navigations reuse one browser context and may reuse HTTP or memory cache; Chromium zero-transfer requests are retained rather than excluded.
This evidence does not test the benchmark namespace.
